LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: The Funeral of the Dead Butterflies
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: The Funeral of the Dead Butterflies (T-01-68) mourns the facility's endless casualties.\nBreaching when workers exceed Fortitude III or fall short of Justice III, it alternates dual White/Black salvos with wide butterfly bursts.
